declarations.docstring: The complex subspace associated with the auxiliary partition of three has dimension two.
The complex subspace associated with the first auxiliary partition of four has dimension three.
The complex subspace associated with the second auxiliary partition of four has dimension two.
The complex subspace associated with the third auxiliary partition of four has dimension three.
For positive size, the complex subspace attached to the auxiliary partition has dimension one.
A permutation acts on the auxiliary one-dimensional subspace by multiplication by its sign.
There is a map between the two auxiliary subspaces of size four that intertwines permutation action with its sign twist.
The representation attached to the first auxiliary partition of four is isomorphic to the indicated auxiliary representation.
There is no linear equivalence between the subspaces attached to the third and first auxiliary partitions of four.
The representation attached to the third auxiliary partition of four is isomorphic to the indicated auxiliary representation.
For positive size, the complex subspace attached to the alternate auxiliary partition has dimension one.
Every permutation fixes each vector in the subspace associated with the alternate auxiliary partition.
The auxiliary statistic of a list consisting of repeated ones is zero.
The indicated auxiliary statistic of the alternate positive-size partition is one.
An auxiliary partition associated with a positive natural number.
A permutation in the indicated set for the alternate auxiliary partition is the identity.
Applying the indicated partition transformation to the third auxiliary partition of four yields the first one.
The representation associated with the first auxiliary partition of four has complex dimension three.
The representation associated with the third auxiliary partition of four has complex dimension three.
A representation isomorphism sends a vector fixed by a group element to a vector fixed by that element.
The hook-length product of the auxiliary positive-size partition equals the factorial of its size.
The hook-length product is the product over cells of the expression computed from sorted row lengths and taller rows.
A product formula computed from a partition's sorted row lengths determines its hook-length product.
The hook-length product of the alternate auxiliary positive-size partition equals the factorial of its size.
Every permutation belongs to the indicated set associated with the auxiliary positive-size partition.
Every permutation belongs to the indicated set associated with the alternate auxiliary partition.
Left multiplication by a permutation scales the indicated auxiliary element by the permutation's sign.
Left multiplication by any permutation fixes the indicated element for the alternate auxiliary partition.
An auxiliary partition of three.
A first auxiliary partition of four.
A second auxiliary partition of four.
A third auxiliary partition of four.
The product of the differences `n - k` for `k` in `range n` equals `n!`.
A vector in the indicated subrepresentation fixed by the swaps of zero with one and one with two is zero.
For distinct indices, acting by their swap evaluates as the negative of the original vector at the swapped coordinate.
Below the list length, the indicated auxiliary statistic of a repeated-one list equals its index.
An alternate auxiliary partition associated with a positive natural number.
A permutation in the indicated set for the auxiliary positive-size partition is the identity.
The indicated auxiliary statistic of the positive-size partition is one.
For every partition, the product of the indicated scalar and associated element is nonzero.
The sorted parts of the auxiliary partition of positive size are a list of that many ones.
A weakly decreasing list representing the parts of a partition is its sorted-parts list.
The sorted parts of the third auxiliary partition of four are three and one.
The sorted-parts list of the alternate positive-size partition is the singleton containing its size.
A permutation in the indicated set fixes the distinguished vector of the third auxiliary partition subspace.
On a one-dimensional partition subspace, if a permutation scales the distinguished element by a scalar, it scales every vector by that scalar.
The transposition swapping zero and one belongs to the indicated set for the third auxiliary partition of four.
The transposition swapping one and two belongs to the indicated set for the third auxiliary partition of four.
A column length equals the number of sorted row lengths strictly exceeding the column index.
A distinguished vector in the complex subspace associated with the third auxiliary partition of four.
The distinguished vector in the subspace for the third auxiliary partition of four is nonzero.
